name: Bun runtime
author: Oven
distributedVia: Compiled into every released binary by `bun build --compile`. Statically links JavaScriptCore (LGPL-2), tinycc (LGPL-2.1) and others — see the text for the full list and the relinking offer.
note: versionSource checks this against the RUNNING Bun, which is what `bun build --compile` embeds (the `packageManager` pin only says what should be installed). bun.txt reproduces this version's LICENSE.md and its statically linked library list, so when Bun is upgraded update this version AND re-copy bun.txt from the matching upstream tag.

name: zstd
selectionReason: BSD-3-Clause branch selected. zstd is offered under either; relying on BSD-3-Clause means no GPL obligation attaches to NarraFork.
author: Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates
distributedVia: Linux static helpers at vendor/zstd/zstd-linux-{x64,arm64}; native Windows ARM64 zstd-win-arm64.exe at dist/helpers/windows-arm64/, built from the same upstream source by scripts/prepare-windows-arm64-helpers.ts for delta updates.

name: ripgrep
selectionReason: MIT branch selected; the upstream Windows ARM64 release supplies LICENSE-MIT verbatim.
author: Andrew Gallant
distributedVia: Six native CLI helpers for Linux/macOS/Windows x64 and ARM64 prepared by scripts/prepare-ripgrep-helpers.ts under dist/helpers/ripgrep/, for separately authorized distribution via the update server tools endpoint.

name: PCRE2 (ripgrep helpers)
author: Philip Hazel, Zoltan Herczeg and PCRE2 contributors
distributedVia: Included in the official ripgrep 15.1.0 CLI helpers (features:+pcre2).
note: Verbatim LICENCE.md from upstream tag pcre2-10.45, including the binary-library redistribution exemption.

name: LLVM compiler-rt
author: LLVM Project contributors
distributedVia: Compiler builtins statically linked into zstd-win-arm64.exe by the pinned llvm-mingw 20250613 cross-toolchain.
note: The verbatim LICENSE.TXT from the verified llvm-mingw archive includes LLVM's full license and exceptions; the compiler executable itself is build-only, not distributed.

name: MinGW-w64 runtime
author: MinGW-w64 project and runtime contributors
distributedVia: Statically linked into native zstd-win-arm64.exe; Windows UCRT system DLLs are not redistributed.
note: Mixed runtime licenses: the complete upstream COPYING.MinGW-w64-runtime.txt notices are reproduced verbatim rather than reduced to a guessed SPDX identifier.

name: musl libc
author: Rich Felker, et al.
distributedVia: Statically linked into the vendor/zstd binaries (compiled in an Alpine container with `-static`).

name: Go standard library
author: The Go Authors
distributedVia: Compiled into the remote executor binaries in remote-executor/dist/, which server/lib/executor-binaries.ts serves to user devices.

name: github.com/bmatcuk/doublestar/v4
author: Bob Matcuk
distributedVia: Compiled into the remote executor binaries (remote-executor/go.mod).

name: github.com/coder/websocket
author: Anmol Sethi
distributedVia: Compiled into the remote executor binaries (remote-executor/go.mod).

name: github.com/creack/pty
author: Keith Rarick
distributedVia: Compiled into the remote executor binaries (remote-executor/go.mod).

name: golang.org/x/sys
author: The Go Authors
distributedVia: Compiled into the remote executor binaries (remote-executor/go.mod, indirect).

name: @parcel/watcher native binaries
author: Devon Govett
distributedVia: Eight platform `watcher.node` binaries embedded by scripts/download-parcel-watcher.ts, which fetches them straight from the npm registry — they never appear in node_modules, so the dependency scan cannot see them.
